target.title: fix(media-understanding): apply image compression policy to media:// references
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`media://` image references (e.g., Slack photos sent through channels) and explicit model calls (`openclaw infer image describe`) were bypassing the image compression policy, causing oversized phone photos to fail with provider dimension limit errors:

```
Error: Image dimensions exceed the 25,000,000 pixel input limit: 4536x8064
Error: At least one of the image dimensions exceed max allowed size: 8000 pixels
```

The image tool correctly applied `agents.defaults.imageMaxDimensionPx` and `agents.defaults.imageQuality`, but media-understanding paths did not, creating an inconsistency that broke real user workflows.

## Why This Change Was Made

The media-understanding module was missing compression logic that exists in the image tool. This fix threads the image compression policy through all media-understanding code paths so they reuse the same `optimizeImageBufferForWebMedia` helper.

## User Impact

- **Before**: Phone photos from channels (Slack, etc.) failed when exceeding provider limits
- **After**: All image paths automatically downsize large images before provider execution

## Evidence

### Code changes
- Extended `normalizeImageDescriptionInput` to accept optional `imageCompression` parameter
- Added compression in `runProviderEntry` for channel-triggered media understanding  
- Added compression in `prepareImageDescriptionInput` for explicit model calls
- Reuses existing `optimizeImageBufferForWebMedia` and `effectiveImageBytesCap` helpers

### Validation
- TypeScript compilation: ✅ No errors
- Unit tests: ✅ 30/30 passing in src/media-understanding/image.test.ts
- Type safety: ✅ ImageCompressionPolicy properly threaded through all layers

## Tests and validation

### TypeScript compilation
✅ No errors across all modified files

### Unit tests  
✅ 30/30 tests passing in src/media-understanding/image.test.ts
✅ Background test runs completed successfully

## Risk checklist

- **Backward compatibility:** ✅ No breaking changes - bug fix only
- **Config contract:** ✅ Uses existing agents.defaults fields
- **Provider contracts:** ✅ Respects Anthropic/OpenAI/etc. dimension limits
- **HEIC conversion:** ✅ Preserved - compression happens before HEIC->JPEG
- **Performance:** ✅ Minimal impact - uses existing optimized helpers
- **Side effects:** ✅ None - only affects media-understanding image paths

## Current review state

Ready for maintainer review. Narrow, source-proven bug fix with minimal blast radius.

---
